python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import gen as G
bad=0; fb=0
for seed in range(2000, 2200):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    req = G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=rng.choice([6,10,16,24]), pathlen=rng.choice([2,3,5,9]) if rng.random()<0.5 else 4,
                          cap=rng.choice([1,2,3,6,10]), equal=rng.random()<0.5)
    line = json.dumps(req)+'\n'
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/dev/main_verify.py'],input=line,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
    b = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/dev/bf.py'],input=line,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=1200)
    if r.stderr.strip(): fb += 1; print('FALLBACK', seed, r.stderr[:200])
    if r.stdout.strip() != b.stdout.strip():
        bad += 1; print('MISMATCH', seed, r.stdout[:200], b.stdout[:200])
        if bad>3: break
print('checked 200 mismatches', bad, 'fallbacks', fb)
EOF
